messages.subject: Rashid settlement — payment breakdown
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert,

As discussed, attached is the payment breakdown for the Rashid settlement showing gross, deductions and net, plus the tax treatment of each element (first £30k of the ex-gratia is tax-free under s.401 ITEPA). Total gross cost is c.£163k; net to Mr Rashid c.£109k. Let me know if you need this in a different format for payroll.

Tom Gallagher

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
